rv.q: This West End transfer is a success – the Ambassadors’ petite stage perfectly conjures a black and white television screen blown up to theatrical proportions. The terror has long worn off these tales, but the chuckles just keep coming.
...even if the show doesn’t always hang together as a whole, it’s still enjoyable and entertaining.
Spooky TV tribute could do with an extra dimension.
The Twilight Zone doesn't exactly make you jump out of your skin as Ghost Stories does - but it has a more psychological impact that gets under your skin instead.
